anomalies.observed: On EthernetAndPower, U3 pin 1 (cathode) is connected to NET0049, which also connects to U11 pin 1 (+); U3 pin 2 (anode) is connected to NET0045, which also connects to U11 pin 2 (−). The battery isolation diode is therefore oriented opposite to the specified battery-to-supply direction.
anomalies.expected: The battery positive should connect to the diode anode, with the diode cathode feeding BAT+; the battery negative should return through the jack switch to GND.

evidence.quote: U3 SS2040FL; pin 1 marked K, pin 2 marked A; U11 pin 1 marked + and pin 2 marked − (EthernetAndPower, page 4/4).
U6: anode on battery (via U7), cathode on BAT+.

anomalies.impact: The cell will not feed the board as intended; with external power present, the reversed diode may instead allow current toward the cell, creating an unintended and potentially unsafe charging path.

parsed.summary: The battery isolation diode U3 is drawn with its cathode toward the battery positive and its anode toward the battery negative-side net, opposite to the specified battery-to-BAT+ orientation. This prevents normal battery operation and may permit unintended current into the cell from an external supply.
